title: Project Audit
description: One reverse-engineering audit of one software project, mapped onto the 7-tool design pipeline (FigJam -> Eraser.io -> Bruno -> Figma -> Prisma Studio -> Plane -> Code + Sentry). Shared by the Field Manual (import/export), the Reverse-Engineering Prompt (agent output), and every audit run.

schemaVersion.description: Integer version of THIS schema. Bump only on breaking changes. Importers must refuse versions higher than they know.

tools.description: Exactly the 7 pipeline steps, keyed by tool, in pipeline order.

figjam.description: Step 1 - FigJam: backbone user journey + MVP cut-line.

eraser.description: Step 2 - Eraser.io: data ERD + API payload contracts.

bruno.description: Step 3 - Bruno: Git-tracked API test collection (auth + endpoints).

figma.description: Step 4 - Figma: 4 UI states (Idle, Loading, Populated, Error) per key screen.

prisma.description: Step 5 - Prisma Studio: database models + Faker seed data (or the stack's ORM equivalent).

plane.description: Step 6 - Plane: discrete tickets with Gherkin acceptance criteria.

codeSentry.description: Step 7 - Code + Sentry: implementation, automated tests, error observability.

topGaps.description: Optional. Gap ids ranked by impact, highest first. Every id must exist in some tools.*.gaps[].id.

repoUrl.description: Clone URL or web URL of the repo. Empty string if not hosted.

commit.description: Optional. Git SHA the audit was run against. Makes the audit reproducible.

stack.description: Primary language. Mixed repos: pick the language of the main app; list the rest in keyLibraries/notes.

framework.description: Main framework, with version when known. e.g. 'Next.js 16.4 (App Router)', 'FastAPI 0.115', 'Django 5.1'. 'none' if none.

auditedBy.description: Optional. Who produced this audit: a person or an agent name.

notes.description: Optional. Free text about scope, access limits, monorepo layout, etc.

status.description: Decision rule: no planning evidence -> 'Not planned'; planned but nothing built -> 'Missing'; both, with >=1 high/medium gap -> 'Partial'; both, no high/medium gaps -> 'Matches'.

equivalentTool.description: Optional. Set when the project uses a different tool for this step. e.g. prisma step in a Drizzle project -> 'Drizzle ORM + drizzle-kit'; in a Django project -> 'Django ORM + migrations'.

planned.description: What the project INTENDED (from README, docs, TODO/FIXME, issues, commit messages).

built.description: What the CODE actually does (routes, models, components, tests, config).

gaps.description: Differences between planned and built, plus missing design artifacts for this step.

artifacts.description: Paste-ready outputs for this tool (outline, diagram-as-code, .bru files, schema, tickets...).

evidence.description: Every file path (optionally path:line) consulted for this step, including where something was searched for and NOT found.

notes.description: Free text. Empty string if nothing to add.

evidence.description: File paths (path or path:line, or 'commit:<sha>', 'issue:#12') that prove this claim.

inferred.description: true when the claim is a reasoned guess rather than directly stated/visible in the evidence.

text.description: What is missing or mismatched, and the consequence.

impact.description: high = breaks users, data, or security; medium = slows the team or hides bugs; low = cosmetic or documentation-only.

ticketRef.description: Optional. Plane ticket key that closes this gap, e.g. 'TURN-14'.

gapId.description: Stable id: GAP-<STEP>-<NN>. e.g. GAP-BRUNO-03. Never renumber; retire instead.

filename.description: Optional. Suggested path when saved, e.g. 'bruno/auth/login.bru'.
